Real Talk · Today
On not seeing everything.
You will not see all of Rome. You will not see most of it. The city has 2,800 years of layers and you have nine days, two of them already half-eaten by jet lag and gelato. The trick is to pick one thing each morning and walk slowly. Today: the Vatican before lunch, then nothing planned until dinner. Sit in a piazza. Let the afternoon get long.
